cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Help me sort our letters before the removal van comes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We filled it over ten years. I shouldn't have to decide alone what survives us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose a day we'll open it together. Taking it away can't mean you inherit all the deciding.
